evals.prompt: Adapt our iPhone portfolio screen to iPad and Android tablets.
evals.expected_output: A layout spec per window size class with navigation changes, list-detail or supporting pane choices, reading width and input behaviour, same destinations as phone.
expectations: Decides layout by window size class, not device
Keeps the same destinations and hierarchy as the phone
Uses a sidebar or navigation rail at larger widths
Constrains reading width with the mobile token
